title: Hook added mid-session: earlier raw output already visible
reason_not_testable: Needs a user to add the PostToolUse hook to settings between two tool calls in one live session. A claude -p run cannot inject that, and a must_not_see across all recorded responses would fail on the first (pre-activation) read by design. Non-hook control: start sessions with the hook already in place and run the canary check (LEAK-0753) before any sensitive read.
